name: Magic Home Restoration
tagline: When disaster strikes, all you need is Magic.

hero.alt: Magic Home Restoration team in front of their purple and yellow emergency response van

maps: Magic Home Restoration, 104 Lake Ave S, Nesconset, NY 11767
facts: Works with all major insurance carriers
intro: Magic Home Restoration is a family-owned Long Island restoration company based in Nesconset. Their crews answer 24/7 for water damage, flooding, fire and smoke, mold, sewage and storm damage, then handle the cleanup and rebuild for homes and businesses across Suffolk and Nassau.

services.d: Burst pipes, ceiling leaks and flooded basements, dried out and cleaned up.
Cleanup and restoration after a fire, including puffback cleanup.
Safe mold removal so your space is healthy again.
Sewage backups, trauma and biohazard cleanup handled with care.
From emergency response to reconstruction, one team start to finish.

why.d: Crews on call around the clock, with a complimentary damage assessment.
They work with your insurance company to keep the claim moving.
Emergency cleanup through rebuild, no juggling contractors.
A family-owned company that treats every home like its own.
